title: SGH (key account) rules
keywords: sgh hospital cold chain pin hamyzan never outsource vivance
body: SGH jobs are never outsourced and never moved to another day without Hamyzan. Any SGH job still pending goes to Hamyzan.
Cold chain PIN: release only after the agent sends a photo showing an identifiable recipient present. All PINs: POD must confirm hand delivery via WhatsApp or KChat.
Reject SGH PODs missing the unit number, cooler box, logger reading or recipient; flag to Hamyzan.
Undeliverable cold chain → return to HQ. Vivance SGH follows SGH rules.
